caption: The drawing shows a dress and several design elements on a plain background. The central object is a long-sleeved, full-length dress colored predominantly in shades of grey, with black shading to represent texture. The dress features decorative pink and lilac details, such as stripes along the chest, cuffs, waist, and along the lower hemline, as well as small pink flower motifs with green leaves scattered across the fabric. There are decorative black patterns within the pink accents and outlining some design areas. To the right of the dress, there is an outline sketch of the back view of the same dress, showing design details without color. Below the sketch, there is a drawing of an ornamental lace or applique design, filled with intricate patterns. In the lower right corner, there is a small colored illustration of a purple flower with green stems and leaves. The overall composition arranges these elements without overlapping, providing a detailed view of the dress and its associated decorative motifs.
title: Visiting Costume
